events.text: Attempted to gut LoaderIsoView into cart/editor. Naive copy is DEAD: GAME_BUILD (the wall/floor placement brain) is transitively welded to 435 propRecipes/* files — even narrow-importing from game/build/index.ts drags all 435. Copying = duplicating the science project into the editor. LoaderIsoView uses GAME_BUILD.catalog/.placed(x20)/.prefabs. Ported Zig doors (runtime/game/build.ts, req_2349) cover picking+validation+catalog-IDs but NOT .placed/.prefabs/full-catalog-rows. So deleting hmsc-int is gated on finishing the Zig build-door port (extend framework/game/build.zig + v8_bindings_game_build.zig to expose placement geometry). Reverted the copy experiment; cart/editor back to buildable with original 4-line seam.
